title: Canonical JSON, scalar parsing and hashing
scope: One admitted value; ordered record stream separately from a materialized JSON document.
proposed_work_bound: O(D + J(D)); hashing/stream emission O(D). J(D) is explicit object-key ordering cost, not an exemption for array/member traversal. Fixed-width time fields O(1); variable-length scalars charged by encoded length and arithmetic cost.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Streaming adapter: O(window + nesting state); materialized API may use O(D) for its explicitly materialized input/output. No archive-total-sized intermediate solely for canonicalization.
semantic_requirement: Keep RFC 8785 ordering, exact scalar domains and rejection of duplicates/invalid values; do not claim arbitrary key sorting is free or promise fixed stack depth for arbitrary nesting.
proposed_witness: Vary arrays, key count, key length, nesting and integer length independently; count bytes/key comparisons and assert exact canonical bytes and invalid-input parity.

title: Typed schema and configuration validation
scope: Maintained fixed-schema documents versus caller-supplied schema, regular expression and recipe predicates.
proposed_work_bound: Fixed declared structural profile: O(D) traversal plus G01 ordering/explicit uniqueness indexing. No unconditional O(D) promise for arbitrary JSON Schema or regular-expression evaluation; such profiles need an explicit algorithm class or a narrower supported profile.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: O(D) for an explicitly materialized document; streaming carriers remain bounded. Alias/recursive expansion and schema recursion must have a documented model, not an accidental total-data ceiling.
semantic_requirement: Separate schema acceptance from cost; malformed or deeply nested input may not trigger uncontrolled expansion. A configuration-size bound is not a collection-size bound.
proposed_witness: Exercise schema branches, uniqueness, nesting/alias amplification and rejection; benchmark maintained validator bodies, not only parse time.

title: Ordered set identities, archive roots and structural commitments
scope: Seal/verify a complete already-ordered inventory, segmented set or root-selected sequence.
proposed_work_bound: O(D + N + O) visits for ordered input; unordered admission may add S(N). Incremental checkpoints add O(delta bytes/records), not a fresh whole-prefix hash per segment.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: O(window) working memory plus O(D + N + O) durable or disk-backed state where required; fixed-size root is not permission to omit records.
semantic_requirement: Ordering, duplicates, missing terminal, exact parent identity and root-last publication remain enforced.
proposed_witness: Count bytes fed to commitments across the entire append sequence; cross pages/segments, then restart before and after root/terminal publication.

title: Age encryption, authenticated ranges and resumable hashing
scope: Encrypt/decrypt bytes or resume a transfer with fixed cryptographic parameters.
proposed_work_bound: O(B + O*kappa); kappa is the declared per-object KDF cost at fixed security settings. Resume adds bytes of bounded replay units, not all prior B after every checkpoint.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: O(concurrency * (crypto window + KDF workspace)); keys/caches separately bounded. In-memory bytes-returning APIs explicitly allow O(B) returned bytes.
semantic_requirement: Do not lower work factor, reuse salts incorrectly, skip authentication, or convert a physical object packing change into an unreviewed archive-format change.
proposed_witness: Count input/crypto bytes, unique KDF operations and replay bytes; vary object count independently of bytes; verify final and resumed ciphertext/receipts under supported failure models.

title: Staged metadata and bounded control bindings
scope: Stage, fetch, validate and bind an exact metadata document or bounded status/control message.
proposed_work_bound: O(D) total metadata intake/transfer plus its declared validation cost; per control call O(p + log Z), independent of the referenced D once accepted.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded transfer windows; O(D) spill/immutable stored representation permitted. Large plans do not get decoded/copied for each status query.
semantic_requirement: Fresh grant, claim, root and control fences survive reuse of immutable validated content.
proposed_witness: Vary plan size with a fixed number of status polls, then vary poll count; count bytes copied/decoded and prove missing/changed/revoked metadata rejection.

title: Official API clients and CLI traversal/presentation
scope: Complete traversal or presentation of a declared remote result.
proposed_work_bound: O(D + Q) client work plus O(ceil(Q/p)) contacts; no repeated complete pagination, whole-result sorting or prefix re-rendering unless that command explicitly requests a materialized sorted result.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Streaming modes O(page/window); explicitly materialized Python/JSON-document output O(D) must be labeled. Terminal rendering work charged to bytes actually emitted.
semantic_requirement: Preserve exact continuation, remote errors, complete result identity and human/JSON parity; downstream slowness must not retain an unbounded transaction.
proposed_witness: Count pages, decoded records and output bytes with slow consumers, cancellation and truncated final pages; use actual client and console paths.

title: Live authorization, claim and fence checks
scope: Authorize a bounded request and exact selected members/resources.
proposed_work_bound: O(Ap + k + I(k,Z)); Ap is applicable policy expression/encoded policy size, k requested members. Fixed scalar checks independent of collection payload/member total.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Request/policy-sized working state; bounded caches of immutable facts only. No corpus-wide permission cache required for normal operation.
semantic_requirement: No caching permission decisions across required checks; no full collection enumeration merely to authorize one exact member.
proposed_witness: Vary unrelated catalog size independently of requested k/policy size; verify late revocation, scope differences and stale claim rejection.

title: Current v1 Alembic baseline, forward-only revisions and pre-v1 hard cuts
scope: Validate each owner's current schema; initialize an empty database via its explicit Alembic v1_0001 upgrade-to-head baseline. Preserve the forward-only revision mechanism for supported v1/future changes, without migration from abandoned pre-v1 application layouts.
proposed_work_bound: Exact current-schema validation O(schema metadata) independent of populated rows. Empty v1 bootstrap processes O(declared DDL/index structures); a separately selected supported forward revision has owner-declared costs in its actually touched rows, bytes, indexes and constraints. A G26 archive-backed derived-index rebuild is charged to required source work, not a legacy-schema conversion.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Current-schema validation O(schema metadata), fresh initialization as declared by v1 DDL. Supported future forward-only revisions own their own working-memory/scratch/retained-state dimensions; no duplicate old/new pre-v1 compatibility tables are required.
semantic_requirement: Preserve forward-only Alembic StateSchema machinery, explicit upgrade-to-head initialization and synthetic later-revision/state-preservation/interruption tests. Before the first v1 RC, update only the application's single v1_0001 baseline/current DDL in place. Startup validates current schema; do not support obsolete pre-v1 migration, aliases or dual layouts. Protect custody and non-rebuildable operational authority.
proposed_witness: Current v1_0001 bootstrap from empty and exact schema validation; synthetic v1_0002 explicit forward-upgrade preservation/rollback/reentry; fail-closed obsolete pre-v1 state; protected archive receipts and derived-index-only rebuild without an old-layout upgrade bridge.
